purpose: Exploratory development replay; no model tuning or release acceptance

source.attribution: L. Shyamal, Driving in Bangalore, C V Raman Road, 2022
source.transform: Full clip resized to 640x360, audio removed, libx264 CRF18; source timestamps retained in derived video; replay resamples to requested analysis rate

before_inference_review.method: Source contact sheet at 0,6,12,18,24,30,36,42 seconds, before running models on this clip
before_inference_review.observations: Daytime divided Indian road, same-direction cars/truck and motorcycles, opposing traffic beyond median, tree shadows and some image blur/camera movement. Sparse stills cannot label temporal encounters or prove an unobstructed path.
before_inference_review.reference_status: No instructor or collision/actor ground truth; do not compute accuracy or credit generic cues as hazard recognition

runs.added_after_initial_runs: Verify clear staleness rejection beyond the 350 ms floating-point boundary

shared_assumptions.speed_30_meaning: Assumed sensitivity input, never a measured speed
shared_assumptions.delay_224_meaning: Fixed sensitivity input informed by first phone capture median; not an Android runtime simulation
shared_assumptions.delay_350_meaning: Boundary stress test of freshness gating; silence does not establish useful perception
shared_assumptions.spatial_geometry: Assumed 110-degree pinhole optics and level gravity only for sensitivity; not calibrated road validation
shared_assumptions.audio: Native submissions and bundled clip durations; no physical audible onset or comprehension measurement

checks: Decision/acceptance linkage, cooldown and duplicate locks
No fabricated speed or spatial availability in semantic-only runs
Speech occupancy, interruptions, repeated cues and scene freshness
Visual inspection of cue capture frames and surrounding source frames
Rerun the four existing development clips in semantic/manual30 mode at 224 ms delay; retain prior results separately
release_gate: Open; ordinary cues require actor relevance, correct timing and independent instructor review. Public-video replay does not qualify phone sensors, mounting, sustained performance, learner benefit or market demand.
